{{Top|leg}}
The '''G9-M concussion mine''' was a concussion [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that was the most widely-used mine in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The G9-M detonated when an enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] came within range, dealing heavy damage to all ships within a wide radius.
